title: Navimower 0.4.3-beta48

## Private-cloud login diagnostics
- Fix a `NameError` in the private mower-cloud login failure path where discovery attempted to record an undefined `path` variable.
- Record failed mower-login discovery against the concrete `/user/user/login` endpoint instead.
- Preserve the original `NavimowAuthError` so regional mower-host fallback can continue probing and expose the real vendor business code/description.
- This is especially useful for the current US/shared-account test path where the account region resolves to `ore` and mower-cloud routing must be verified independently of local exceptions.
